business_snapshot: Persistent Systems Limited is a global technology services company delivering digital engineering, cloud, and software product development services. It operates across multiple verticals including Software, High-Tech and Emerging Industries, Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI), and Healthcare and Lifesciences.
trajectory_summary: Persistent Systems has consistently compounded its top line over multiple consecutive quarters, crossing ₹4,664 Cr in quarterly sales by Sep 2026. However, operating profit margins have compressed recently down to 14% in Sep 2026 due to integration expenses, higher depreciation, and financing costs.

narrative_vs_numbers.management_narrative: Management emphasized strong acceleration in software reinvention offerings, broad-based enterprise demand, and continued sequential scaling.
narrative_vs_numbers.actual_numbers_delivered: Sales: ₹4,056 Cr, OPM: 19%, Net Profit: ₹529 Cr

narrative_vs_numbers.management_narrative: Highlighted the signing of the business combination agreement with Nagarro to create an AI-led global engineering powerhouse, guiding for sustained profitable growth.
narrative_vs_numbers.actual_numbers_delivered: Sales: ₹4,303 Cr, OPM: 16%, Net Profit: ₹483 Cr

narrative_vs_numbers.management_narrative: Reported securing 94.04% of Nagarro share capital under the open offer and emphasized robust TCV bookings of USD 633.5 million while absorbing acquisition-related one-time expenses.
narrative_vs_numbers.actual_numbers_delivered: Sales: ₹4,664 Cr, OPM: 14%, Net Profit: ₹352 Cr

cash_quality.cfo_to_pat_ratio_3yr: Cumulative operating cash flows remain healthy, with Mar 2026 generating ₹1,767 Cr in CFO against a net profit of ₹1,865 Cr.
cash_quality.working_capital_trend: Debtor days have increased from 62 days in Mar 2024 to 83 days by Sep 2026, leading to an expansion in working capital days to 50 days.
cash_quality.leverage_and_roce: Borrowings increased from ₹451 Cr in Mar 2024 to ₹575 Cr by Sep 2026 to fund strategic growth and acquisitions, while ROCE expanded impressively to 34.4%.
cash_quality.diagnostic_verdict: Accounting profits continue to convert reasonably well into cash flows, though lengthening debtor days require close monitoring.

forward_guidance: Expecting final regulatory FDI and merger control approvals from Austria and Spain for the Nagarro acquisition over the coming weeks.
Focusing on executing the squeeze-out of remaining minority shareholders of Nagarro following the successful 94.04% acceptance under the open offer.
Driving future growth via Software Reinvention and AI-native product engineering offerings across global enterprise clients.
bull_case: Strong multi-year revenue compounding history with 26 consecutive quarters of sequential top-line expansion reaching USD 487.6 million in Q2 FY27.
Successful acquisition of Nagarro creating an AI-led global engineering powerhouse with over USD 2.9 billion in revenue run rate and 46,000+ professionals.
Consistent expansion in ROCE reaching 34.4% alongside robust enterprise TCV bookings of USD 633.5 million.
bear_case: Compression in recent operating margins, with OPM dropping to 14% in Sep 2026 due to integration expenses, higher depreciation, and exceptional one-time costs.
Stretching working capital metrics, evidenced by debtor days rising to 83 days in Sep 2026.
Geographic concentration risks, as demonstrated by a temporary 8.5% year-on-year decline in European revenue due to client-specific ramp-downs and M&A events.
primary_sources_used: Audited Consolidated Financial Statements & Multi-Year Tables (Persistent Systems Ltd)
